exercises.question: Why was the journey difficult? [¿Por qué fue difícil el viaje?]
options: Because the ship suffered a breakdown and the delay became unavoidable. [Porque el barco sufrió una avería y el retraso se hizo inevitable.]
Because Odiseo had already reached his destination. [Porque Odiseo ya había llegado a su destino.]
Because there was no luggage at the beginning of the journey. [Porque no había equipaje al principio del viaje.]

exercises.sentence: Sabíamos que todavía debíamos __ muchos obstáculos. [We knew that we still had to overcome many obstacles.] (to overcome)
exercises.english: We knew that we still had to overcome many obstacles.
The journey was difficult, but we managed to continue the journey.

sentences: Primero llegó una tormenta. [First a storm arrived.]
Después el barco sufrió una avería. [Then the ship suffered a breakdown.]
Finalmente continuamos la travesía. [Finally we continued the journey.]

exercises.question: Which sentence combines a past problem with its earlier background? [¿Cuál combina un problema pasado con su contexto anterior?]
options: Habíamos reservado el alojamiento, pero el tren llegó tarde y perdimos la conexión. [We had booked the accommodation, but the train arrived late and we missed the connection.]
Reservaremos el alojamiento, pero si el tren llega tarde perderemos la conexión. [We will book the accommodation, but if the train arrives late we will miss the connection.]
Reservamos el alojamiento ahora, pero el tren siempre llega tarde y perdemos la conexión. [We book the accommodation now, but the train always arrives late and we miss the connection.]

exercises.sentence: Nos dirigimos hacia el centro, aunque todavía no __ dónde pasaríamos la noche. [We headed towards the centre, although we still did not know where we would spend the night.] (saber)
exercises.english: We headed towards the centre, although we still did not know where we would spend the night.

exercises.question: What happened after the storm? [¿Qué ocurrió después de la tormenta?]
options: The ship suffered a breakdown. [El barco sufrió una avería.]
Odysseus immediately reached Ithaca. [Odiseo llegó inmediatamente a Ítaca.]
The crew cancelled the return journey. [La tripulación canceló el regreso.]

exercises.question: Why did Odysseus look for an alternative? [¿Por qué buscó Odiseo una alternativa?]
options: Because the breakdown ruined the original plan. [Porque la avería arruinó el plan original.]
Because he wanted to leave Ithaca. [Porque quería salir de Ítaca.]
Because he had no destination. [Porque no tenía destino.]

exercises.question: What does the final paragraph suggest about the journey? [¿Qué sugiere el último párrafo sobre el viaje?]
options: The difficulties were part of what gave the journey meaning. [Las dificultades formaron parte de lo que dio sentido al viaje.]
The destination was completely unimportant. [El destino no tenía ninguna importancia.]
Odysseus regretted travelling at all. [Odiseo se arrepintió de viajar.]

exercises.sentence: Habíamos reservado el alojamiento, pero el tren llegó tarde y perdimos la conexión.
options: We had booked the accommodation, but the train arrived late and we missed the connection.
We booked the accommodation after the train arrived early.
We were going to cancel the accommodation because the journey was short.

exercises.sentence: Si encontramos una alternativa, continuaremos el viaje esta noche.
options: If we find an alternative, we will continue the journey tonight.
If we found an alternative, we continued the journey yesterday.
We continued the journey because we had found no alternative.

exercises.sentence: Nos dirigimos al centro, aunque todavía no sabíamos dónde pasaríamos la noche.
exercises.english: We headed towards the centre, although we still did not know where we would spend the night.

exercises.sentence: La travesía fue difícil, pero conseguimos superar los problemas que surgieron.
options: The journey was difficult, but we managed to overcome the problems that arose.
The journey was easy, so we cancelled the problems.
The journey will be difficult, but we have already arrived.
Llegó tarde, perdimos la conexión y ahora necesitamos una alternativa. [It arrived late, we missed the connection and now we need an alternative.]
Llegará tarde, perderemos la conexión y ahora necesitamos una alternativa. [It will arrive late, we will miss the connection and now we need an alternative.]
Llegue tarde, perdamos la conexión y ahora necesitamos una alternativa. [It arrives (subjunctive) late, we miss (subjunctive) the connection and now we need an alternative.]
Si encontramos otro transporte, continuaremos el viaje esta noche. [If we find another form of transport, we will continue the journey tonight.]
Si encontremos otro transporte, continuaremos el viaje esta noche. [If we find (subjunctive) another form of transport, we will continue the journey tonight.]
Si encontraríamos otro transporte, continuaremos el viaje esta noche. [If we would find another form of transport, we will continue the journey tonight.]
Ha sido difícil, pero hemos conseguido superar los problemas. [It has been difficult, but we have managed to overcome the problems.]
Haya sido difícil, pero hayamos conseguido superar los problemas. [It has (subjunctive) been difficult, but we have (subjunctive) managed to overcome the problems.]
Sea difícil, pero consigamos superar los problemas. [It is (subjunctive) difficult, but we manage (subjunctive) to overcome the problems.]

template.prompt: Explain a travel problem, what you did about it, and what you will do next.
template.answer: El tren llegó tarde y perdimos la conexión. Buscamos una alternativa y continuaremos el viaje esta noche.

template.prompt: Describe a hypothetical alternative to a difficult journey.
template.answer: Si tuviera más tiempo, elegiría otra ruta y viajaría con más calma.
